source: claude-api skill (models.md, prompt-caching.md), 2026-11-01. Edit here; every run records the table it used in config.json and report.json.
notes: cache_write is the 5-minute-TTL write price (1.25x input); the runner only uses the 5-minute TTL.
cache_read is 0.1x input except Opus 5.5 (0.05x, $0.20) and Fable 5.1 (0.025x, $0.25).
Haiku 5.5 prices apply to prompts of 100K tokens or fewer; eval prompts are a few thousand tokens.
output includes thinking tokens (billed as output even when the thinking text is not returned).
